crossRefs.note: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

translations.web: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.
translations.bsb: Better to be lightly esteemed yet have a servant, than to be self-important but lack food.
translations.kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
translations.asv: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that honoreth himself, and lacketh bread.
